title: FRAME SAMPLING STRATEGIES MATTER: A BENCHMARK FOR SMALL VISION LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates Small Vision Language Models (SVLMs) on video question-answering benchmarks (VideoMME and MVBench) under controlled frame-sampling strategies (uniform FPS, single-frame, and adaptive algorithms like MaxInfo and CSTA). It compares these standardized results against literature-reported scores to quantify the discrepancies and cross-model ranking shifts caused by inconsistent frame selection protocols.
